checks: Independent practice attempts start with no task credit, both trunk ports shut in access mode and VLAN 99 absent; PC addressing and access ports are preconfigured
Published IOS commands configure matching static trunks, DTP suppression, native VLAN 99, exact allowed lists and saved startup configurations
All three PC pairs exchange actual replies in both directions; switch ports use normal STP forwarding without PortFast
Observed ICMP frames carry VLAN 10/20 tags on the trunk, native VLAN 99 crosses untagged, access delivery is untagged and switches preserve IP TTL
Removing VLAN 20 from one trunk breaks only the VLAN 20 pair; adding it back restores actual traffic
A native-VLAN mismatch breaks the native pair while tagged traffic continues; matching native VLANs restore connectivity
Missing VLANs, shutdown and disabled cable break actual forwarding; corrective configuration recovers it
Both switches must learn all three remote PC MAC addresses dynamically on Gi0/24 in their correct VLANs; clear and reload require fresh learning
Published switch and PC verification commands work; cross-VLAN pings fail without a router
Portable saves and switch power cycles retain configuration; stable device IDs preserve objectives after host rename and earned echo observations survive reload
Imported allowed lists reject duplicates, empty or invalid VLANs and oversize arrays; native VLAN and negotiation values validate as bounded data
scope: Uses the existing switching, packet, STP, DTP and MAC-learning engines. No simulation-engine changes, server backend or unimplemented configurations added. Native-VLAN endpoints demonstrate untagged forwarding within this lab.
